title: OJK Tindak 3 Pelanggaran di Pasar Modal
blurb: A summary of OJK enforcement in three cases: PANR market manipulation, misleading BOGA IPO-fund reporting, and falsified client portfolios with unauthorized share sales by a former WPPE. The post covers the related sanctions and restrictions. This is an educational summary of OJK documents, not personal audit experience or investment advice.

title: GAO menemukan seorang manajer menyetujui invoice kontraktor meskipun dokumen pendukungnya tidak cocok dengan jumlah pembayaran.
blurb: A case-based note on why a correct payment amount is not enough: reviewers still need to resolve, document, and evidence discrepancies before approval. This is a reading of GAO-21-420R, not a personal audit experience.

title: Pernah dengar orang bilang organisasinya punya sertifikasi ISO 9001?
blurb: This post distinguishes ISO’s standards-setting role from third-party certification and explains that ISO 9001 sets management-system requirements. Certification does not guarantee perfect product conformity.

title: Rilis MSCI 15 Oktober mencatat pelaku pasar menilai kemajuan belum terlihat konsisten.
blurb: The post summarises MSCI’s proposed review of Indonesia’s market classification, the consultation timeline, and concerns raised about market functioning and evidence of reform. It does not present the proposal as a final reclassification.
